summary: Stateful BR Brain: capture-first, dual-path speech protection and conservative silence batching.

changes.title: Dual-path neural speech protection
changes.detail: Compare aligned original and denoised Silero scores with independent recurrent history, energy attenuation and padded speech context. Recover attenuated speech by smoothly blending original samples. Reuse one VAD session per batch in the isolated denoiser, with raw fallback on any failure.

changes.title: Conservative speech gain and continuous capture
changes.detail: Apply bounded speech-aware gain only near speech, preserve every sample and the existing continuous dictation overlap and thought-aware batching. No audio storage or network access. Device accuracy and latency validation remain pending.

changes.title: Verify bundled neural endpoint models
changes.detail: Extend the existing GTCRN contract test to require the exact new auxiliary ONNX allowlist and mandatory endpoint hash verifiers. Preserve the opt-in-only Parakeet policy.

changes.title: Keep original audio through successful transcription
changes.detail: Retain raw PCM in RAM until protected decode returns. Retry original once on decoder failure or empty output with sustained raw speech evidence, and wipe it on success/cancellation. Preserve exact auxiliary model allowlist and existing security gates.

changes.title: Immediate tap-to-record
changes.detail: Dispatch a normal microphone tap on release without the double-tap confirmation delay. The previous mic double-tap keyboard switch is available as an opt-in setting. Stop and Cancel remain responsive during startup; preserve hold-to-talk and private-mode guards.

changes.title: Capture-first model preparation
changes.detail: Prioritize the audio thread and use 40 ms PCM reads. After real audio arrives, prepare Silero first, queue Parakeet warm-up separately and prepare Smart Turn while the ordered PCM queue continues accepting frames. Renew the ASR idle lease and expose a RAM-only request-to-first-PCM timing in Offline voice settings. No recording to disk.

changes.title: Stateful streaming GTCRN and dual-path endpointing
changes.detail: One isolated child per adaptive dictation session, 640 ms blocks with 16 ms alignment lookahead, uninterrupted GTCRN recurrent/STFT state and independent raw/clean Silero histories. Protect each block using neighboring context before selecting quiet batch boundaries. Retain raw overlap and original PCM; timeout/cancel/crash disables the child and falls back to raw for the remainder of the session.

changes.title: Conservative silence compaction
changes.detail: Compact only long outer digital-zero runs confirmed as non-speech by both detectors; retain speech padding and all nonzero quiet samples and internal pauses. Thought completion sees protected audio with natural pauses. Speech-aware gain runs on the ASR batch. Existing adaptive batching toggle allows reverting to isolated batch enhancement. Smart Turn remains the verified endpoint model; English-only candidate accuracy and physical-device performance still require benchmarking.
